android.releaseNotes:
NexPlay 2.0.3 - rebased onto OpenNOW android-native 2.0.3.

New: HDR output, stream recording, gyroscope input, touch controller skins and presets, 12 locales, settings backup, bug report threads.

Security: APK updates now require the manifest to publish a sha256 and are re-verified at install time; release builds trust only system certificate roots; the live broadcast stream key is no longer written to logs.

Tests: 1169 unit tests.
